explanation: The observed downstream output omits stipulated record n06-r06, even though n06-r06 is an allowed record identity and has a matching downstream capability (cap-compare). Job 2 appears to consume and preserve the two upstream handoffs exactly; its input needs and evidence_sources already exclude n06-r06. The upstream select_demand source selects only demand_score >= 6 plus fallback_ids ['n06-r07','n06-r08'], so the stipulated n06-r06 record with demand_score 5 is silently dropped before the downstream job can process it.
cited_evidence: Top-level corpus includes record_id n06-r06 with need 'compare selected and complete runtime evidence', demand_score 5, source_id s06, source_weight 3.
Job 2 input needs and evidence_sources contain n06-r01 through n06-r05 plus n06-r07 and n06-r08, but not n06-r06.
Job 2 capabilities include {'capability_id':'cap-compare','need':'compare selected and complete runtime evidence'}, showing the omitted n06-r06 need had a direct capability mapping available.
Upstream select_demand source: selected_df = corpus_df[(corpus_df.get('demand_score', 0) >= 6) | corpus_df.get('record_id', '').isin(fallback_ids)] with fallback_ids = ['n06-r07', 'n06-r08'].
